protocol.data_role: procedural mechanism evidence; exposed and additional conditions separate
protocol.dense_cap_scope: retained J only; CUDA peak includes Gram/solve temporaries and live worker tensors
protocol.missing_policy: retain all failures including solve errors; no fallback or selective rerun
protocol.objective: raw 0.5 mean squared RGB error, whole image, no mask/display clamp in fitting
protocol.order: rotate seven-arm order by seed; separate warmed process per cell
protocol.positive_gate: all84cells complete and integrity-valid before any stratum passes
protocol.primary: full_shared vs block_shared, per family and exposure stratum
protocol.ridge: per-row .01*max scaled diagonal, diagonal floor1e-12; identical across full/block
protocol.scoring: raw MSE; PSNR floor1e-12 and uncapped counterpart; display-clamped MS-SSIM/LPIPS
protocol.secondary: full_row vs block_row separately; full arms vs strongest Adam separately
protocol.system: same dense J,g=JTr/numel,H=JTJ/numel; only cross-row mask and cap scope differ
protocol.terminal: exact160 attempted updates; terminal state, no best selection
protocol.timing: complete fit and all inner work, descriptive only on shared GPU
